featured_reviews.name: Harsh Vijay
featured_reviews.review_text:
This was my third surgery for shoulder dislocation. My last two ligament repair surgeries failed because I didn’t follow physiotherapy properly, so this time after a Latarjet procedure I was determined to take rehab seriously. On Dr. Dinshaw Pardiwala’s recommendation, I joined this physio centre after 4 weeks—and it’s honestly the best decision I made.

The doctors are extremely knowledgeable, friendly, and explain everything in detail, helping you understand your body at a physiological level. I’ve been doing physio here for the past 8 months, and the improvement has been amazing—I’m now able to swim and bowl again. Special thanks to Preksha ma’am for handling this division so brilliantly. Highly recommended.

featured_reviews.name: Jasmine Chabria
featured_reviews.review_text:
‘Healed & Jumping. FREE of pain’ - Thanks PhysioRehab  Doctors!

🟢 What happened:
- Diagnosed with Disc Degeneration
- 2-3 years of lower back pain. Frequent muscle spams. Days when I couldn’t even walk to the restroom
- Going crazy as I couldn’t find a doctor who could correctly diagnose & treat it.

Then finally I was recommended PhysioRehab Powai.

🟢 When I met Dr Sneha & Dr Anjana at PhysioRehab Powai:
- From the moment I walked in, the space was so welcoming, vibrant and friendly. Lights up the mood! Dr. Anjana, Dr. Sneha & Dr Anushka took ample time to listen attentively to my concerns (I think I cried too!) and thoroughly assessed my condition. Their super-deep knowledge, true concern and comforting nature, and professionalism were evident throughout the entire session. I was told to do all that is told and I will be pain-free. I  made the pact!
- A personalized Physiotherapy + Aqua plan was tailored to my specific needs, and Dr Sneha explained each step clearly and concisely. Super patient doc! Dr Sneha describes in detail how each exercise/technique needs to be done and why. So it benefits the correct muscle.
- Dr Sneha & Dr Anjana make sure we enjoy the process. Their energy is contagious! They come from a background of wealth of scientific knowledge and mental models.

🟢 Today, I have fully recovered & living life to my peak
- FREE of pain.
- I feel more energetic than I did in my 20’s. (PS: I’m 34)
- I’m able to do all tasks/movements needed by a common human and love it!
- Thanks to them, I’ve made fitness and exercise a part of my routine. I still go for Pilates And customized physiotherapy for better mobility, and flexibility to PhysioRehab Powai.
Lastly, planks upto 60 secs. (big smile)

Overall, my experience at PhysioRehab Powai with Dr. Sneha & Dr Anjana was exceptionally healing. Thank you Dr. Sneha, Dr. Anjana, Dr. Anushka, and the entire team for your care, amazing knowledge across physiotherapy-neurology-&other specialisations, and commitment to helping your patients achieve their wellness goals.

I do believe in angels. And they’re angels :)
